title: Settings
profile.title: Profile
profile.villainTitleHint: Shown next to your name, for example “Baron of the Eastern Marshes”.
timeZoneHint: Deadlines and countdowns use this time zone. It's currently {{time}} in {{city}}.
languageHint: Choose the language for menus, emails and alerts. Your minions will still answer in whatever language they like, and the death ray only understands binary anyway.
notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.heroSightings: When a hero is spotted near the lair
notifications.schemeFoiled: When one of your schemes is foiled
notifications.quietHours: Quiet hours: no alerts between {{start}} and {{end}}
roleDescriptionHenchman: Henchmen can run schemes, assign minions and fire gadgets, but they can't change billing or delete the lair. Give this role to people you trust with the death ray, though not with the keys to the volcano.
apiKeyShownOnce: Copy this key now. For security, we'll never show it again, not even if you threaten us.
transferOverlordshipHelp: Hand the lair to another member. They become the overlord and you become a henchman, with no way to take it back unless they hand it over again. Choose someone who won't immediately lock you in the dungeon.
deleteLairConfirm: Delete {{lair}} and everything in it? Type the lair's name to confirm.
deleteLairWarning: Deleting the lair removes every scheme, device, minion record and blueprint for good. Active heists are cancelled and henchmen lose access straight away. This can't be undone, not even with the time machine.
